answer: A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the yarrow graph. Re-attestations are stored in inlet and pearl lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 3470 identities would post 4204 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
